name: FSBM
recent: FSBM Holdings 近期有多项企业活动：与 Kilsa Malaysia 签署合作备忘录，涉及马来西亚科技解决方案；Warrants B 持续转换，分四批共发行约 117 万股新股；董事及大股东出现股权变动，包括一名董事辞任及一名大股东退出。此外，公司有一项重大诉讼，并更改财政年度结束日。
notable: 与 Kilsa Malaysia 签署合作备忘录，合作提供马来西亚科技解决方案。
Warrants B 分四批转换，共发行约 117 万股新股，发行价每股 RM0.05。
董事 MR CHAN KEA YONG @ CHAN KEA HEE 辞任。
risks: 公司涉及一项重大诉讼。
Warrants B 持续转换导致新股发行，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
董事及大股东近期有股权变动，包括董事减持及大股东退出。
earnings: 2026 财年第二季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 1038.4 万令吉，环比增长 9.2%，同比增长 191.7%；净利为 158.8 万令吉，环比增长 51.7%，净利率为 15.3%，高于上一季度的 11.0%。

recent_en: FSBM Holdings has seen several corporate developments recently: it signed an MOU with Kilsa Malaysia for technology solutions in Malaysia; Warrants B were converted in four tranches, issuing about 1.17 million new shares; there were changes in director and substantial shareholder interests, including a director's resignation and a substantial shareholder ceasing to be one. The company also has a material litigation and changed its financial year end.
notable_en: Signed an MOU with Kilsa Malaysia to collaborate on technology solutions for Malaysia.
Warrants B were converted in four tranches, issuing about 1.17 million new shares at RM0.05 each.
Director MR CHAN KEA YONG @ CHAN KEA HEE resigned.
risks_en: The company is involved in a material litigation.
Ongoing conversion of Warrants B leads to new share issuance, which may dilute existing shareholders.
Recent changes in director and substantial shareholder interests include a director reducing holdings and a substantial shareholder exiting.
earnings_en: For Q2 FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM10.384 million, up 9.2% QoQ and 191.7% YoY; net income was RM1.588 million, up 51.7% QoQ, with a net margin of 15.3%, higher than 11.0% in the previous quarter.
